description:
UK Garage royalty Sunship remixes Athletes of God and Lady Blackbird’s Don’t Wanna Be Normal into a club-ready UK garage classic. The single includes the original remix & the dub.

Household name Sunship needs little introduction. Started his career as an original member of the Brand New Heavies to then releasing his Mobo Award winning self-titled album ‘Sunship’ which was followed by the chart-topping album ‘This Real’ with tracks like All I Want, One Night Stand and the garage anthem Flowers all of which were in the top 5 in the UK charts. Sunship is also a prolific remixer, reworking tracks by Craig David - his remix of 7 days receiving the ultimate accolade of pure battering on the pirates and in the clubs, Gabrielle, Mary J. Blige and Kelly Rowland and now Athletes of God and Lady Blackbird.
